MOON PATROL DIAGNOSTICS Turn switch #8 of DIP switch #2 to the ON position and turn power ON. The MOON PATROL diagnostic program consists of 8 independent tests, 2 of which are automatic at turning power ON in diagnostic mode: RAM Test and ROM Test. After these two tests have been properly completed, pressing the 2 Player button brings an index of the other tests to the RT display: 01 DIP SWITCH 02. +1-0 PORT* 03 SOUNDS 04 CHARACTER 05 COLR 06 CROSS HATCH PATTERN * Control! Panel and Coin Door switches test. As any test other than 02 is completed, pressing the 2-Player button returns the test index to the monitor display. When test 02 is completed, the joystick lever must be moved left while pressing the 2 Player bufton to return the test index. If no further testing is desired, turn power OFF and return switch #8 of DIP swith #2 to the OFF position. RAM Test !f checked to be OK, "RAM OK" appears on monitor. If not OK, "RAM NG XXXX yy 22" appears on monitor (without ROM test results). * Faulty RAM address RAM Input Data RAM Output Data If RAM is shown to be NG at address EOOO=E7FF failure can have occurred in either 38 RAM or 2K decoder. If RAM is shown to be NG at address 8000=87FF failure can have occurred at RAM chip 3C or circuitry directly associated with the RAM chip--Chips 7J, 7K, 6A, 5D, 6D, 4A, 4B, 4C, and 4D of the Scrolling Video board or chip 5M of the CPU board. A faulty chip must be replaced to continue diagnostics. ROM Test \f checked to be OK, the display below appears on the monitor. ‘RAM OK" "ROMO OK FF! "ROM 1 OK FF! "ROM 2 OK OFFI "ROM 3 OK FF" \f any are not OK, for example ROM 1; this appears on monitor. 'R AM Nc" "ROMO OK FFU "ROM 1) NG) OFF" "ROM 2 OK FF" "ROM 3 OK FFY A faulty ROM must be replaced to continue diagnostics.

01 DIP SWITCH Test Shows state of all switches contained in DIP switches #1 & #2 and the resulting game adjustments; as in Example 1-1. Examp!e 1-1: DIP Switch Recommended Settings 0 = OFF, 1 = ON DIP SW 12345678 sWi 10000000 SW2 01000101 PATROL CARS 4 ‘ ADDITIONAL CARS POINTS 10, 30, 50 THOUS AND DIP SW- Test Example 1-1 (Cont.) COIN MODE 1 COIN 2 PLAYS BODY TYPE UPRIGHT 'f any switch(es) of a DIP switch set is (are) not represented correctly, the respective DIP switch set or any of chips IE, IF, 1H, or 2d could be mal functioning. Switch #8 of DIP switch #2 is shown as "1" only because that is the position required tor game diagnostics. 02 1-0 PORT (Control! Panel/Coin Door Switch) Test Shows if all controls and coin mechanisms are functioning property by displaying a matrix composed of he states of switches on the Contro| Panel and Coin Door as shown in Example 1-2. Example 1-2: O = OFF 1 = ON 12345678 KEY 0 00000000 KEY 1 00000000 KEY 2 900000000 TIMUNG 0000 The TIMING number starts at 0000 and adds one count approximately every second. If any Control Panel or Coin Door switch is closed a "i" will appear in the above matrix as follows: 1 Player Start Button KEYO-1 2 Player Start Button KEYO-2 Coin Switch A KEYO-4 Joystick Right (Faster) KEY1I-1 Joystick Lett (Slower) KEY 1-2 Jump KEY 1-6 FIRE KEY 1-8 Coin Switch B KEY2-5 Coin Switch B is present only in games with coin doors that accept coins of two different values. To end this test and return to test index: move joystick lever left while pressing the 2 Player Start Button.

03 SOUNDS Test A list of sounds normally produced by the game appears as shown below on the monitor. Move joystick lever as necessary to light the number of the sound desired to test and press the 1 Player start button for repetition of the sound. 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 Vi 12 13 14 Example 1-3: EXPLOSION (ROCK) PASSING ONE POINT UFO EXPLOSION MISSILE FROM CAR COIN CAR JUMP SPACE PLANT UFO FLYING BACK. GROUND MUSIC ENDING MUSIC OPENING MUSIC REACHING GOAL CONGRATULATION CAR EXPLOSION 04 CHARACTER Test A display composed of 8 tanks vertically and horizontally flipped as shown below appears on monitor. Wi = RED [ ]=VIOLET =GREEN TANK = GRN TREADS = GRN TREAD WHEELS = VIOLET GUN = RED

05 COL Test This test consists of 5 independent steps as follows: 1. An alphanumeric display is shown as below over a row of numbers 0 thru 9, letters blue and numbers white. ABCDEFGH | JKLMNOPGRS TUVWXYZ 0 123456789 2. Acolor pattern is displayed as shown: 10 10 va 10 RED GREEN BLUE 7 *Numbers are the ratio of size used for each color. black white 7 30 3. A field of red is displayed. 4. A field of green is displayed. 5. A field of blue is displayed. Each independent step of this COL( test can be advanced through by pressing the 1 Player start button. 06 GROSS HATCH PATTERN Test A white line matrix 16 lines vertical x 16 lines horizontal is displayed.
